response.justification: Bogdan has strong technical leadership and event-driven systems experience, but lacks direct exposure to multi-agent AI systems in fintech, real-time credit risk, or regulated financial environments. His recent AI-agent infrastructure work at re:cinq is promising but not yet demonstrated at scale. The resume shows versatility across tech stacks but misses critical domain depth in agentic AI architecture and fintech infrastructure.
strengths: Strong backend and distributed-systems expertise with event streaming and microservices (Dunnhumby, Optilyz)
Proven engineering leadership in scaling teams and processes (Altom Consulting, RIDE Capital)
Recent hands-on work with AI-agent infrastructure and developer tooling (re:cinq)
concerns: No explicit production experience with multi-agent AI systems in commercial or financial contexts
Limited fintech infrastructure experience (only general backend roles, no credit/liquidity systems)
Lacks regulatory/compliance exposure in high-stakes financial environments
